items.text: Raiders listing TE Brock Bowers as doubtful for Sunday vs Chargers due to knee injury, per HC Klint Kubiak. He returned to practice Friday but remains doubtful; expected back Week 3.
items.why: Knee injury; returned to practice but HC designation
items.implication: Sit Bowers; Michael Mayer elevated to lead TE and viable starter

items.text: Nico Collins (hamstring Grade 1) DNP Friday after Wednesday injury and Thursday DNP; not expected to play Sunday vs Bengals. Status in jeopardy earlier, now lean OUT. History of hamstring issues.
items.why: Grade 1 hamstring strain, multiple DNPs, source reports not expected
items.implication: Sit Collins; boost to remaining Texans pass-catchers

items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) returned to practice Friday after two DNPs; limited appearance. If OUT, Ravens WR hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore. Ja'Kobi Lane on IR.
items.implication: Monitor final report/GTD; Bateman flex if sits
items.opportunity: Bateman lead role if Flowers inactive

items.text: Vikings ruled out QB Kyler Murray (concussion) for Sunday vs Bears. Carson Wentz starts again.
items.implication: Jefferson remains strong with Wentz history; Wentz streaming option

items.text: Falcons ruled out QB Michael Penix Jr. (knee) for Sunday vs Panthers. Cooper Rush will start, Jack Strand backup.
items.why: Not quite ready, Rush taking first-team reps
items.implication: Downgrade Falcons pass catchers slightly; Rush game manager

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson ready to go for debut. Unclear how much volume he steals from Rhamondre Stevenson, but timing perfect: Pats desperate for explosives with AJ Brown on IR, strong upcoming schedule (PIT/JAX/BUF/LV etc before bye).
Chargers WR Ladd McConkey DNP second straight day (ribs) Thursday, making it unlikely he plays Sunday vs Raiders. Day-to-day earlier.
items.implication: Sit McConkey; Quentin Johnston and others elevated

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: handled 21/24 RB touches (74% snaps), 40% routes targeted (tied team lead), 24% target share in Chiefs debut. IND just gave up 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry. RB1 overall in range of outcomes.
LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: Utilization Score 99 in Week 1 (tied Bijan for lead). 19% target share recent, 25+ touches in 3 of last 4. Overreaction to injury scare.
LOVE Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz Week 1; averages 93 yds/18 PPG in 6 career games with Wentz. CHI soft vs WRs.
items.implication: Elite WR1 play despite Murray OUT

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore suffered AC joint sprain in shoulder Thursday night (ruled out mid-game); not serious, day-to-day with chance to play next week vs Chargers but not lock.
LOVE DeVonta Smith @ TEN: 27% target share, 13.7 aDOT, three deep looks Week 1. TEN allowed high catch rate/YPR; bounceback incoming.
items.why: Usage + soft matchup after slow Week 1

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: career-high 26% target share, out-routed Gainwell by 8, all RB red-zone touches. CLE allowed 121 rush yds/4.8 YPC.
HATE Travis Etienne @ BAL: matched Miller rushes Week 1, most points via air; Kamara expected back squeezes role further. Underdog script bad for rushes.
